anchors.prompt: Same patio photo as the reference, late afternoon but still bright daylight: the doctor stands next to the big clay pot of parsley (with some stems freshly cut), holding a watering can, looking at the viewer. Everything else identical.
Same patio: he has put the watering can down on the bench and stands next to the pot, relaxed, looking at the viewer.
Same patio: he points at the outer stems of the parsley pot, explaining.

Close-up of a small new clay pot on the wooden bench with dark soil and a young parsley seedling, his hands holding its small root ball, about to press it in. Same place, same light and same objects as the first image, now seen in close-up.
Same close-up: the seedling now firmly planted, his fingers pressing the soil around it, a few drops of water on the leaves.
Same patio, wide: he stands next to the bench with the small new pot beside the big parsley pot, brushing soil off his hands, smiling at the viewer.
Same patio: he holds a freshly picked parsley stem near his nose, nodding.
Same patio: he points down toward the bottom of the frame, casual smile.
Same patio: he crouches next to the parsley pot, smiling warmly at the viewer.
Same patio: he waves goodbye to the viewer with a big smile, a parsley leaf in the other hand.

clips.text: Y bueno, aquí volvemos, al principio. Al perejil. Que cuesta casi nada y lo tienes en cualquier verdulería.
clips.action: He waters the parsley pot a little, puts the watering can down and looks at the viewer.

clips.text: Si lo quieres tener en casa, una maceta así, con sol de la mañana y riego seguido, y cortas de afuera hacia adentro.
clips.action: He touches the outer stems of the pot showing where to cut, then glances up at the sun.

clips.text: Y compra un plantín, no semillas, que tardan muchísimo en salir. Un plantín, y en dos semanas ya estás cortando.
clips.action: Close-up: his hands press soil around a small parsley seedling in a new clay pot, then give it a little water.

clips.text: Y cuando florece, se pone amargo. Así que ve cortando seguido, que eso lo mantiene tierno.
clips.action: He cuts one stem from the big pot with his fingers, smells it, and nods.

clips.text: Te dejo la receta entera en el video, y la hoja para que le saques foto. La guía de la firmeza está abajo, para el que quiera más.
clips.action: He points at the camera, then down toward the bottom of the frame, casual.

clips.text: Y cuéntame en los comentarios cuántos años tienes y si lo vas a probar. Los leo todos, de verdad.
clips.action: He crouches next to the pot again, smiling, and mimes typing a comment with his thumbs.

clips.text: Nos vemos en el próximo. Y esta noche: algodón, perejil, y a dormir. Cuídate mucho.
clips.action: He picks one parsley leaf, holds it up with a wink, and waves goodbye to the viewer.
